comment: Outline ink (currentColor) of every HST theme: Colibre's #3A3A38 on light and #FAFAFA on dark surfaces, so HST glyphs match the Colibre icons beside them. heavy16 widens 1 px pens to 2 px at 16 px where the glyph has room (scripts/brand/hst_icon_weight.py); off since 1.0.2: it made only some 16 px icons 2 px, heavier than their neighbours and than the Colibre icons (scripts/brand/check-hst-icon-weight.py).
